# Phobos Framework: equipment and item reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-item-reference.ps1. Edit config/item-reference.json, not this file. -->

Current source candidate: **0.57.0**. Game target: **1.0.1.5**. Values below come from offline definitions; they do not establish installation, gameplay validation or a live merchant quote.

Framework supplies shared services rather than a set of standalone machines. Since 0.57.0 it also owns the two lines every Phobos mod shares, the gas line and the process-water line, so any mod's machines can pipe to any mod's stores. Its shared repair remainder can appear while servicing equipment from any participating Phobos content mod. Construction menus, machinery controls and the opt-in Scope recorder are interfaces, not additional inventory objects. Crew standing orders are opt-in; see [crew work, training and time-skips](crew-automation.md) for eligible work, approved stores, resource limits and resuming industrial and exterior work. Compact controls, unsaved settings and object selection are explained in the [control-panel guide](control-panel-guide.md). In selection fields, Locate opens a temporary marked ship view; Clear is a draft change that requires Apply. Pick on ship marks eligible objects and Escape restores the panel and view.

**Reading prices:** credits per complete object at the stated condition, before shop margins, market effects, negotiation and extra wear. Pristine retail can cost more. Mass is the empty/dry definition or fresh commodity template; saved contents and variable recovery packets can weigh differently. Dismantle value is the sum of all listed outputs at base value, excluding labour and tools.

**Repair and Restore:** Repair fixes a damaged form and retains the actual consumed service materials as spent parts. Restore reduces wear on functional equipment in place; it does not grant pristine status. Empty cargo and follow the machine’s local maintenance guards first. Work speed depends on crew, tools and current condition.

**Finding stock:** the generated percentages are defaults per eligible native stock/loot roll, not per ship or guaranteed shop availability. Offers are additive, may be independent, and require normal restocking. Merchant offers request the listed finite lot when successful; separate world-loot branches retain their own listed quantities. Configuration, capacity and native generation rules still apply; loading an existing save does not refill its inventories.

**Stacking:** limits below apply to loose items on the ground or in compatible containers; 1 means no multi-item stack. Installed equipment remains individual. Limits count objects, not kilograms, and do not change merchant lot sizes or per-object contents.

## Spent Service Parts

Material physically retained from the actual repair bill after replacing worn or broken components.

**Use:** Collect or haul the spent parts after repair; sell only where a buyer accepts the cargo.

**Where it appears:** Native Repair jobs on supported Auto Nav, Shipbreaker and Agriculture equipment.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

The definition below is a template. Live mass follows the real consumed repair lot, including old jobs with different bills. No current refining recipe returns new electronic or mechanical parts.

Full operating instructions: [Spent Service Parts guide](equipment-economy.md).

<a id="gas-line"></a>

## Gas line

Sealed Fennmark gas line joining gas stores and the machines that fill or draw from them: Manufacturing's stores, V4, X2, K2, AX-2, LC-3, SA-3, P1, L2 and A2, and Shipbreaker's T2 for methane. Every machine and store whose gas port the line reaches joins one network, and touching equipment joins without it. It has its own lane, so it shares tiles with other lines. Its retained waste is what dismantling leaves.

**Use:** Lay it through INSTALL > HVAC on intact floor from port to port. The gas port is the tile beside the middle of each machine's or store's right-hand side, turning with it. A damaged segment breaks the network there until repaired.

**Where it appears:** Sold new at the K-Leg supply kiosk and fixer, San Diego Halvorson and the Venus scrap kiosk in lots of 128. Ordinary supply. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.

**Placement:** INSTALL → HVAC. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Moved from Manufacturing to Framework in 0.57.0 with its saved identity, name, price and bills unchanged, so it no longer needs Manufacturing installed. It holds no gas between transfers; hold-up and pressure drop are neglected. When an oxygen store and a fuel store share one line, the stores' panels and the crew log say so; nothing is blocked. The retained waste is terminal.

Full operating instructions: [Gas line guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

<a id="water-line"></a>

## Process water line

Sealed line for process water between water tanks (Shipbreaker's silos, Agriculture's reservoirs) and the machines that draw or make water: Manufacturing's V4, X2, K2, LC-3 and SA-3, Shipbreaker's T2 and Agriculture's W2 intake. Every machine and tank whose water port the line reaches joins one network, and touching equipment joins without it. It has its own blue lane, so it shares tiles with other lines.

**Use:** Lay it through INSTALL > HVAC on intact floor from port to port. The water port is the tile beside the middle of each machine's or tank's left-hand side, turning with it. Then link the machine to the tank on its Control Panel; the list shows how each tank is reached.

**Where it appears:** Sold new at the K-Leg supply kiosk and fixer, San Diego Halvorson and the Venus scrap kiosk in lots of 128. Ordinary supply. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.

**Placement:** INSTALL → HVAC. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

New in Framework 0.57.0. Process grade only: it never joins drinking water. It holds no water between transfers. Irrigation conduit is a separate line for the W2's racks. The retained waste is terminal.

Full operating instructions: [Process water line guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).

## Evidence and upkeep

Item names, dry/template masses, prices, service bills, salvage outputs, placement tabs, stock probabilities and table recipes are generated from current Phobos definitions. **Blue Bottle Games’ Ostranauts** native `DataCO.GetBasePrice` supplies the offline valuation used here ([developer’s game page](https://bluebottlegames.com/games/ostranauts)). That page identifies the game; the actual numeric evidence is the locally inspected assembly, whose hash is retained in the generated data snapshot. No proprietary source or game assembly is distributed.

Function/use explanations are maintained in the reviewed catalogue. All fictional prices, yields and simplified processing are Phobos gameplay choices. Research attribution remains beside the relevant claims in the linked operating/research guides. See [reference maintenance](development/item-reference-maintenance.md) for the one-click updater and coverage checks.
